Inside the Lab

Two hours, built to move.

A deliberate arc: from mindset, to business impact, to a single Fierce model, to hands-on application and organizational integration.

01 20 min

Fierce Foundations & Leadership Context

The core Fierce mindset, why conversations fail, and framing the leadership tension at the heart of the session.

02 15 min

Business Impact Framing

Connecting the topic to accountability, trust, burnout, performance, change resistance, and execution challenges.

03 30 min

Fierce Model Deep Dive

One focused Fierce model per session: accountability, feedback, conflict, change, or coaching.

04 40 min

Interactive Application

Breakout discussions, reflection exercises, facilitated dialogue, and real-world application to your team.

05 15 min

Organizational Integration

Implementation, leadership consistency, organizational impact, and next-step opportunities.
